name: push-up
title: Push-Up
primer: This exercise is the main strengthening exercise when wanting to strengthen one's chest, shoulders, and triceps as well as core muscles.
steps: Lie face down on the floor, or a mat, with your feet together curled slightly so you rise onto the balls of your feet.
Place your hands shoulder width apart on either side of your chest.
Exhale as you raise your body up until your arms are straight.
Keep your head and neck level with your body (don't look up or down) and don't allow your back to rise or fall.
Inhale as you lower your body back to the ground.
